entries.body:
Summary of work so far (round 1 of 11 released; rounds 02-11 not yet released):

Round 1 files: board.md, changes.md, logs/{shipping-svc,checkout-api,auth-svc,inventory-svc,search-api}.log
- board.md round 01: header only ("# Incident board: updates in round 01"), no thread updates yet.
- changes.md round 01: "CHG-107 APPLIED: retry budget for idempotent GETs set to 1" (possible later relevance, e.g. BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT).
- Log format observed: "2026-09-14T08:03:33Z ERROR inventory-svc dns lookup failed host=rates.internal err=SERVFAIL" and "<ts> WARN  <svc> slow query ms=<n> table=<items|orders|events>" (format may change in later rounds).

Findings round 1:
- Candidate incident DNS_RESOLUTION on inventory-svc: repeated ERROR dns lookup failed host=rates.internal err=SERVFAIL at round-01/logs/inventory-svc.log lines 7, 20, 50, 54, 57, 62, 65, 85, 86, 89, 90 (increasing toward end of hour, 08:58-08:59). Not yet on board.
- Slow-query WARNs (ms ~214-443) appear across all services (shipping 59 lines, checkout 55, auth 78, inventory 90, search 71 lines total). Looks like background noise, not an incident so far.
- search-api.log output was truncated after line 17; no errors were seen in the part that printed. It may be worth re-checking search-api for non-WARN errors.

Incidents/status: none declared on board yet. Follow-ups opened: none yet.

Next steps: optionally grep search-api.log fully; then {"action":"advance"} to release round 02. Each round, read board.md (latest update per thread wins; unmentioned = unchanged), changes.md (APPLIED vs PROPOSED), and scan logs for ERROR/new formats. Track causes (including superseded ones), services, status and follow-up codes with file:line refs. Final answer only after all 11 rounds.

[step 2] execute
thought: Save notes to file; check remaining errors in search-api briefly.
code:
open('/task/workspace/notes.md','a').write('R1: CHG-107 APPLIED retry budget GET=1 (round-01/changes.md:3). inventory-svc DNS SERVFAIL rates.internal lines 7-90 of round-01/logs/inventory-svc.log. Board empty. slow query WARN noise everywhere.\n')
L=open('/task/fixtures/round-01/logs/search-api.log').read().splitlines()
for i,l in enumerate(L,1):
  if 'ERROR' in l: print(i,l[:140])
